resources.string: A little learning, over any app.
Front and back float together over other apps, changing every 30 seconds by default. Enable Display over other apps when prompted.
Saved-audio folder selected; device speech is the fallback.
Audio uses device speech. A readable media folder can provide Anki recordings.
Displays text fields, not custom card templates or cloze formatting. Includes child decks. No review history is changed. Sessions may pause during sleep or battery restrictions.

Your notes stay on this device. AnkiDroid requests a read/write API permission; this app only queries it. Notification content is marked private on the lock screen. Device speech uses an offline voice when available.
Ready. Start when you want to study.
Study session running. The floating card appears over other apps.
Install AnkiDroid, open it once, and enable its API in Settings → Advanced. Then connect again.
AnkiDroid access was not granted. Sample mode still works.
Allow notifications in Android settings before starting.
Choose a whole-number interval from 5 to 3600 seconds.
No matching notes. Check the deck and front/back field names.
Could not load AnkiDroid. Check its API permission and selected fields, then try again.
Card hidden until the next scheduled change.
